title: Bozhou rebellion
text: The Bozhou rebellion, or the Yang Yinglong rebellion, was an uprising led by Yang Yinglong, a chieftain of the Miao tribes located on the border of the Ming provinces of Huguang, Guizhou, and Sichuan in southwestern China. This rebellion took place in the 1590s and was aimed at challenging the rule of the Wanli Emperor.
